# Git Repository Rules

- Every commit message follows **Conventional Commits** — `type(scope): description` — and references the active MCP task as `[TASK-xxx]` in the subject or body (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) → Commit Conventions).
- This ensures full traceability between code changes and the project task system.
- Propose a draft commit message that is clear, concise, and focused on "why" rather than just "what", followed by the task metadata.

## Gemini CLI

For running this MCP server inside Gemini CLI, see the [GitHub Wiki — Getting Started](https://github.com/vheins/local-memory-mcp/wiki/en/Getting-Started) → "Gemini CLI & Antigravity" (`~/.gemini/settings.json`).
